svg.title: Prompt, Check, Publish: back cover
svg.desc: Back cover. Write once. Check every step. Publish everywhere. Change one number in a dataset, and every document built from it should change too. This book shows how: you write prose and code once, in plain text, and Quarto rebuilds a web page, Word, PDF, slides, an e-book, a website, a blog and a dashboard from that one source. A coding agent writes the code at a speed that was out of reach until recently; you direct it one small step at a time and check its work against the data. Two real projects: a London visitor guide, with cited figures, maps and openly licensed photographs; and drinking-water risk in Colombia, with public data for every municipality, explored and clustered. No programming is assumed. Ravi Kalia.

text.font-family: 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
